title: Contractual metric gating & tenant-level retention packaging experiment
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Experiment to validate a modular pricing/packaging construct that ties tenant-level observability retention and a Compliance Pack to explicit contractual metrics (SLA uplift, monthly spend threshold, and security questionnaire completion). Goal: determine feasibility of gating upgraded retention/Compliance Pack behind contractual commitments + automated questionnaire completion, and measure conversion, revenue uplift, and support cost delta.
acceptance_criteria: Define two offer variants (Tier A: 90-day retention + standard compliance checklist; Tier B: 365-day retention + Compliance Pack + premium SLA) and publish pricing sheet
Implement a gating flow in the Console that prevents upgrade to Tier B unless contract metric (signed MSA or committed monthly spend >= $10k) is recorded or automated questionnaire marked complete
Instrument analytics to capture conversion rate, MRR delta, and average onboarding time for gated vs ungated tenants
Legal approves sample contract language for SLA uplift and data retention terms
Run a 6-week pilot with 20 enterprise customers and collect qualitative feedback from account teams
notes: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with GTM, Legal, and Solutions Eng. Agreed scope: test retention length + Compliance Pack as upsell tied to contract metrics rather than feature flags alone.
2026-02-18: Engineering (ENG-4021) scoped Console API changes required for tenant-level retention overrides and a new entitlement flag. Estimate: 3 sprint points + QA.
2026-02-22: Legal requested explicit language for data retention liability in MSA — drafted clauses in Confluence (see artifact link).

2026-02-25: Product-design reviewed gating UX. Trade-off: inline questionnaire increases friction but reduces manual sales work; agreed to progressive disclosure with 'Request Upgrade' CTA leading to a short automated questionnaire.

2026-03-01: Solutions Eng reported one customer (ACME Media) willing to pilot Tier B if SLA includes 99.9% inference availability and 50ms p95 latency target on dedicated pools. Note: this may require Dedicated capacity pricing adjustments.
2026-03-03: Pricing workshop — suggested list price for Tier B is 2.5x baseline per-token unit given hosting and retention costs; agreement to A/B test 2.0x vs 2.5x during pilot.
2026-03-04: Security requested that questionnaire completion be auditable and produce an exportable PDF for contract annex; engineering accepted as requirement for pilot.

2026-03-05: PM sync — gating MVP will use enrollment via Sales console + self-serve path if customer completes questionnaire and accepts contract language. Next: prepare pilot materials and enable analytics events.

Ship Console entitlement flag + questionnaire flow (ENG) — feature branch and PR by 2026-03-12
Prepare sales pilot pack (Sales + SE) including pricing variants and objection handling — 2026-03-15
